item_short_desc: Show your US Navy pride displaying your Rothco US Navy Round Patch. This military patch is 3" round, made from cotton, polyester material. The US Navy patches feature an embroidered navy insignia and easy sew on or iron on application. Officially Licensed by the United States Navy.
